comments.author: harmony
comments.body_html:
I am aware that this already has been added. Find userDefinedNames.json at mod directory inside nameData folder and add as many custom names as you’d like to both USEC and BEAR, like this:

{
  "USECNames": ["123"],
  "BEARNames": ["434", "111"]
}

As for now, the only way you can use your own pool is just deleting everything from default names manually you don’t need/want and use your custom names
